description: Defines an abstract class DateTimeWizard implementing Wizard interface for handling date/time formats in PHPSpreadsheet styling, including methods for escaping characters, wrapping literals, and formatting output.

classes.name: DateTimeWizard
classes.description: An abstract class providing helper methods for date/time format string manipulation within PHPSpreadsheet style number formatting.

methods.name: padSeparatorArray
methods.description: Pads an array of separators to a specified count, repeating the last separator as needed.

methods.name: escapeSingleCharacter
methods.description: Escapes a single character if it is not in the set of characters that don't need escaping.

methods.name: wrapLiteral
methods.description: Wraps string literals in quotes or escapes single characters appropriately.

methods.name: intersperse
methods.description: Concatenates a format block with a separator, if provided.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns the format string representation of the object.
